purpose: Canonical schema for traceable sourced career, skill, qualification and labour-market evidence.

career_fact.display_rule: A sourced fact must resolve to a canonical entity and provenance link before display.

rules: Never overwrite original source values when normalizing.
Never merge source taxonomies without preserving source identifiers and mapping notes.
Never infer individual aptitude from aggregate labour-market data.
A research page being readable does not mean its data is integrated or reusable.
Cached or curated snapshots must retain access date, version, checksum where available, and licence/terms reference.
Heuristics and demo fixtures must remain distinguishable from sourced facts.
